content: This unique approach to community detection allows us to exploit preference similarity information across speeches and voting habits without requiring states to be similar on both dimensions. Formally, our vote-speech layered network is a node-aligned INLINEFORM0 undirected multilayer network INLINEFORM1 with no self-edges INLINEFORM2 . The multilayer network is node aligned because we add extraneous nodes such that INLINEFORM3 where typically the INLINEFORM4 . Such an approach is shown in the literature to yield mathematically desirable properties for the task of multilayer community detection BIBREF26 and is also required for the TERGM estimations.
